articles.title: ISRO lines up 7 launches, including uncrewed Gaganyaan mission by March 2026
articles.summary: ISRO has planned seven crucial launch missions by March next year. These include demonstrating indigenously built electric propulsion systems for satellites and pioneering quantum key distribution technologies. This ambitious lineup highlights India's significant advancements in space technology, enhancing self-reliance and securing a strong position in cutting-edge communication and space exploration for national strategic advantage.

articles.title: Links 12/14/2025
articles.summary: An antique French Flajoulot singing bird box, a rare mechanical masterpiece from the early 1900s, was highlighted. This intricate automaton exemplifies historical engineering brilliance and precision craftsmanship. SSB aspirants can appreciate the ingenuity in such vintage devices, showcasing early technological advancements and the importance of detailed mechanical design.

articles.title: No football in Valencia: Levante-Villarreal postponed due to the storm
articles.summary: The LALIGA EA Sports match between Levante UD and Villarreal CF, scheduled for this Sunday at 18:30, has been officially suspended. The decision was announced due to reasons that will be elaborated further in the full report. Fans are advised to monitor official club channels for updates regarding potential rescheduling or ticket information. This suspension affects the ongoing league's matchday fixture.

articles.title: Thailand confirms first civilian killed in week of Cambodia fighting
articles.summary: Thailand has reported its first civilian casualty amid a week of intense border fighting with Cambodia. Despite failed international efforts to mediate, the violence has escalated, displacing hundreds of thousands from their homes. This ongoing conflict underscores regional instability and the urgent need for a peaceful resolution to prevent further humanitarian crisis and loss of life.

articles.title: AIIMS-led trial proves indigenous stroke device matches global standards
articles.summary: AIIMS New Delhi successfully led India's first clinical trial of an indigenously tested advanced stroke device. This significant breakthrough promises to dramatically improve access to timely and affordable stroke treatment across the nation. The success signifies a major leap in neurovascular care, potentially reducing stroke-related disability and mortality and enhancing healthcare accessibility, particularly in remote regions.

articles.title: Ukraine war sparks European march towards conscription
articles.summary: Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine has compelled European governments to critically reassess the strength of their conventional forces. Nations are now asking tough questions about their armies' capacity for effective defence, highlighting a widespread need to bolster military readiness and capabilities across the continent. This re-evaluation is crucial for maintaining security in the evolving geopolitical landscape.
